Latest News

The online application registration for State Sponsored Meritorious Scholarship Schemes is being extended w.e.f. 27th March 2019 to 5th April 2019
All Students are directed to approach their Institution for Updating / Editing Institution Profile after that COURSE will be shown after COURSE mapping by the concerned Institution.
The dates for online application verification is being extended w.e.f. 27th April 2019 under various stateCentral Sponsored Schemes for the year 2018-19 due to Lok Sabha Election 2019
Last Date for Online Registration on HP e-PASS Portal for New Institutions Registration for the year 2018-19 is started w.e.f. 04-10-2018 to 31-12-2018. The Format for New Institutions Registration must be submitted in this Directorate through E-mail Hard copy upto 31-12-2018. After 31-12-2018 no Registration Format shall not be entertained.
Last Date of Registration / Submission of Online Scholarship Application by the Students (studying within outside the state) 31st December 2018 (04-10-2018 to 31-12-2018)
Last Date of taking a printout of Online Application Form submitting the same along with the Scheme Specific Document(s) by the student(s) to their respective Institution(s). 31-12-2018.Note: Out of State Students are advised to mention the following address on the Form (where the form needs to be sent) while submitting the Print out other documents to the concerned institution: Director of Higher Education Himachal Pradesh Shimla 171001.
All Heads of the Institution(s)/In-charge(s) are directed to check the Notification on the Portal in Download menu regarding Misuse of Scholarship funds fraud Claims.
All Students are directed to fill their Bank Account Number with proper IFS Code. Jandhan Bank account is not valid for Scholarship application if already filled same should be change immediately.
All Heads of the Institution(s)/In-charge(s) are directed to fillup the Aadhaar Seeding Format which is already avilable on the e-pass Portal further submitted to the concerned bank otherwise Institutions will be fully responsible for any lapes.
All students are directed to registeredfill up the application form within a stipulated period i.e. upto 31-12-2018 otherwise Students will be fully responsible for any lapes. Dates for online registration of the students application will not be extended.
All Private Institutions should submit the undertaking on the prescribe format (copy available on the portal) on judicial paper at earliest. The payment under PM-SC/ST/OBC/EBC Scheme for the year 2017-18 (Fresh) will be released on the basis of submission of the under taking by the Private Institutions otherwise Institutions will be fully responsible for delay of eligible Student Scholarship payments.
Notification regarding Fixation of Scholarship amount upper limit under CSS Post Matric SC/ST/OBC for the year 2015-16 onward available in the portal.
